SELECT ( SUBSTR(EMAIL_TRACSCEIVE_DATETIME, 1, 4) || '/' || SUBSTR(EMAIL_TRACSCEIVE_DATETIME, 5, 2) || '/' || SUBSTR(EMAIL_TRACSCEIVE_DATETIME, 7, 2) || ' ' || SUBSTR(EMAIL_TRACSCEIVE_DATETIME, 9, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(EMAIL_TRACSCEIVE_DATETIME, 11, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(EMAIL_TRACSCEIVE_DATETIME, 13, 2) ) AS EMAIL_TRACSCEIVE_DATETIME , CASE WHEN EMAIL_TRANSCEIVE_TYPE_CD = 'R' THEN '수신' WHEN EMAIL_TRANSCEIVE_TYPE_CD = 'S' THEN '송신' ELSE EMAIL_TRANSCEIVE_TYPE_CD END AS EMAIL_TRANSCEIVE_TYPE_CD , EMP_ID , OPPONENT_EMAIL_DOMAIN_ADDR , FILE_ATTACH_YN , FILE_ATTACH_SIZE , EMAIL_TITLE , DEPARTMENT_CD , REG_DATETIME , INSPECTION_YN , CALL_RULE_RESULT FROM IF_EMAIL_TRANSCEIVE_INFO WHERE 1 = 1
AND EMP_ID LIKE '%' || #{empId} || '%'
AND EMAIL_TRANSCEIVE_TYPE_CD LIKE '%' || #{emailTransceiveTypeCd} || '%'
AND TO_DATE(SUBSTR(EMAIL_TRACSCEIVE_DATETIME, 1, 8), 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{fromDt}, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(#{toDt}, 'YYYYMMDD') ORDER BY EMAIL_TRACSCEIVE_DATETIME DESC , EMP_ID ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IF_EMAIL_TRANSCEIVE_INFO WHERE 1 = 1
AND EMP_ID LIKE '%' || #{empId} || '%'
AND EMAIL_TRANSCEIVE_TYPE_CD LIKE '%' || #{emailTransceiveTypeCd} || '%'
AND TO_DATE(SUBSTR(EMAIL_TRACSCEIVE_DATETIME, 1, 8), 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{fromDt}, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(#{toDt}, 'YYYYMMDD')
